title: Finance budget - weekly sync prep (run-rate & procurement)
content:
Meeting: Weekly finance sync - prep notes (run-rate review, spend reviews, procurement approvals)
Owner: Priya Desai
Attendees (requested): Jordan, Maya, Alex (PT), Ops rep if available
Date/Time: Thursday weekly slot; confirm 10:30-11:00
Location: #finance-weekly Zoom / notes in this doc

Objectives:
- Quick run-rate sanity check vs. forecast (keep under 2 slides, numbers only)
- Review top 5 overrun items and mitigation proposals
- Procurement approvals: 3 requests (see details below) - aim to approve or assign owners
- Action items and next steps for Exec summary by Friday EOD

Prep numbers (quick reference):
- Current monthly run-rate (Feb snapshot): $2.1M/mo (total OpEx incl. infra credits)
- Forecast (end of Q1): $2.05M/mo (targeted reductions from infra optimizations)
- YTD variance: +4.2% vs plan (mainly infra + third-party integrations)
- Headcount spend (run-rate): $1.05M/mo (~50% of run-rate)
- Infra (GPU/cloud): $560k/mo (~27%); notable spike week of Feb 7 due to load test
- Subscriptions/third-party: $180k/mo (contract renewals in Apr/May)

Key items to call out in sync: (bulleted talking points - short)
1) Infra spike root cause & fix status
   - Feb 7 load test: unexpected autoscale; cost spike ~ $48k one-time
   - Mitigation: set stricter autoscale cap + pre-test reservation plan (Jordan owning)
   - Action: Jordan to confirm reservations by EOD Fri and share updated forecast row
2) GPU utilization improvements (Optimize proposals)
   - Expected savings if we implement batching + prefix caching: ~12% infra cost reduction (est $67k/mo)
   - Risk: small latency regressions on tail; SRE/serving will validate on canary
   - Action: Maya to coordinate rollout plan with serving-runtime; propose timeline next week
3) Contract renewals coming up (Apr/May)
   - Lists: Dataplane monitoring (renew Apr 20), OCR vendor (May 3)
   - Recommendation: renegotiate term to 12 months with volume discount; target 8-10% savings
   - Action: Alex to own vendor outreach; draft negotiation points prior to next sync
4) Procurement approvals (requests in queue)
   - PR-1298: Dedicated infra reservation for Dedicated customers - $240k one-time capex (finance approval required)
   - PR-1301: New monitoring tool (annual) - $42k/yr (Ops + SRE recommendation)
   - PR-1312: Small SaaS tool for legal redaction - $9k/yr (compliance OK)
   - Decision goal: approve PR-1301 & PR-1312 if no objections; discuss PR-1298 funding cadence (capex vs operating)

Open questions to raise
- Do we want to reclassify some infra spend to COGS for Dedicated customers? (affects gross margins and run-rate reporting)
- Any objections to accelerated procurement approvals for under-$50k SaaS items via PO backlog instead of full board memo?
- Do we have runway headroom target at 12 months vs 18 months for enterprise push? (need final answer from PLG growth)

Quick agenda (10:30-11:00):
- 10:30-10:32: Quick numbers snapshot (me)
- 10:32-10:38: Discuss infra spike + GPU optimization status (Jordan & Maya)
- 10:38-10:45: Procurement queue decisions (walk PRs)
- 10:45-10:54: Contract renewals & vendor negotiation plan (Alex)
- 10:54-11:00: Assign action items + confirm Exec summary owner

Notes to self / things to bring:
- Print small table of top 10 cost line items (from spreadsheet) - link: https://sheets.internal/redwood/finance-q1-runrate (copy snapshot into slide)
- Check if AWS credits applied for Feb overrun (billing team)
- Pull recent SLO traffic to verify if new batching will affect SLO buckets (ask Maya/SRE)
- Prepare 2 slide deck: Slide 1 = run-rate numbers + variance; Slide 2 = procurement asks + risks + owner

Proposed follow-ups (post-meeting):
- Friday EOD: Exec summary (1 page) - owner: Priya (draft), reviewers: CFO & Head of Product
- Jordan: confirm reservation plan and update forecast row (due Mon 03/08)
- Maya: rollout timeline for batching/caching canary (due Mon 03/08)
- Alex: vendor outreach & negotiation doc (initial outreach by Mon 03/08)
- Ops: confirm monitoring tool ROI and implementation plan (due Tue 03/09)

Action item checklist (quick):
- [ ] Exec summary draft (Priya)
- [ ] Confirm infra reservation (Jordan)
- [ ] Canary rollout plan (Maya)
- [ ] Vendor negotiation doc (Alex)
- [ ] Approve PR-1301 + PR-1312 (finance meeting decision)

Scratchpad notes (for meeting):
- If CFO pushes for 18-month runway, propose temporary hiring freeze on non-critical roles + pause external contractor RFPs (saves ~ $120k/mo)
- Consider moving some infra to committed savings via cloud partner (long lead procurement but bigger % savings)
- Tag items for exec-level attention with yellow highlight on slides

End of doc - will iteratively update after sync.
